title: Tsang Chiu Ho Building

buildingCutout.basis: Selectively replaces coincident generated geometry at the seven-point original corner building in the 2024–2026 period.

terrainReference.basis: Lands Department bare-earth class on the Wellington Street pavement immediately in front of the 2024 shop.

mapIdentity.provider: Named OpenStreetMap survey of the Tsang Chiu Ho Building and government planning record A/H3/449B
mapIdentity.scope: The named seven-point footprint fixes the building at the Wellington Street and Aberdeen Street corner. The Town Planning Board confirms the address and records the ground and two upper commercial floors with six residential floors above.

note: Original photographs from the same 18 May 2024 series establish the glazed red shopfront, projecting green signs, first-floor dark bands, and orange and cream residential facade. Official native Hong Kong 1980 Grid ground elevations fix the neighborhood slope.
